edits.text: PARTIES. This Executive Employment Agreement is entered into by and between Vireo Systems Inc., a Delaware corporation, and the Executive, effective as of the date of the Executive's commencement of employment.
edits.name: Parties clause revision

edits.text: 1. POSITION. The Executive shall serve as Chief Operating Officer and shall perform the duties and responsibilities customarily associated with that position, together with such other duties as are reasonably assigned by the Chief Executive Officer and consistent with the Executive's role and seniority.
edits.name: Position clause revision

edits.text: 2. COMPENSATION. The Executive shall receive an annual base salary as approved by the Board or the Compensation Committee from time to time, payable in accordance with the Company's ordinary payroll practices, and shall be eligible to participate in the Company's benefit plans made available to similarly situated senior executives, subject to the terms of those plans.
edits.name: Compensation clause revision

edits.text: 3. SEVERANCE. If the Executive's employment is terminated by the Company without Cause, then, subject to the Executive's execution and non-revocation of a customary release of claims and continued compliance with post-employment obligations, the Executive shall receive the severance benefits set forth in the applicable severance schedule or offer terms agreed by the parties.
edits.name: Severance clause revision

edits.text: 4. RESTRICTIVE COVENANTS. During employment and for twelve months following termination of employment, the Executive shall not engage in competitive activity to the extent prohibited by applicable law and only within the geographic territory and business lines in which the Executive had material responsibility during the final twelve months of employment. The parties agree that this Section shall be construed and enforced only to the maximum extent permitted by applicable law.
edits.name: Restrictive covenant clause revision

drafter.message_to_opposing_counsel:
Counsel,

Please see revised draft. We have removed the reference to unspecified offer terms for severance, tied any severance benefits to a Board-approved attached schedule, preserved release and compliance conditions, and revised the covenant language to maintain companywide protections for confidential information, customer relationships, and non-solicitation obligations, in each case subject to applicable law. Best,
Aldous Finch LLP

edits.text: 2. COMPENSATION. The Executive shall receive an annual base salary as approved by the Board or the Compensation Committee from time to time, payable in accordance with the Company's ordinary payroll practices. The Executive may be eligible to participate in any annual bonus, equity, incentive, retirement, welfare, and other benefit plans or programs made available to similarly situated senior executives, in each case subject to approval by the Board or the Compensation Committee, the terms and conditions of the applicable plan documents, and the Company's generally applicable policies. Nothing in this Agreement guarantees any salary increase, bonus payment, equity award, or other incentive compensation.
edits.name: Compensation revised per Board/Committee approval and no-guarantee position

edits.text: 3. SEVERANCE. If the Executive's employment is terminated by the Company without Cause, then, subject to the Executive's execution and non-revocation of a customary release of claims in a form reasonably acceptable to the Company and the Executive's continued compliance with all post-employment obligations, the Executive shall receive only the severance benefits, if any, expressly set forth on a severance schedule attached to this Agreement and approved by the Board or the Compensation Committee. No severance benefit shall be payable by reference to any oral understanding, unsigned term sheet, unapproved offer term, or other arrangement not expressly incorporated into such approved schedule.
edits.name: Severance tied to approved attached schedule

edits.text: 4. RESTRICTIVE COVENANTS. During employment and for twelve months following termination of employment, the Executive shall comply with the Company's restrictive covenant, confidentiality, inventions, non-solicitation, and related obligations applicable to senior executives, including any obligations set forth in this Agreement or in any separate agreement between the Executive and the Company. Without limiting the foregoing, the Executive shall not, to the maximum extent permitted by applicable law: (a) use or disclose the Company's confidential information except as authorized in the course of employment; (b) solicit, induce, or encourage any customer, prospective customer, supplier, vendor, business partner, or other material business relationship of the Company to terminate, reduce, or adversely modify its relationship with the Company; or (c) solicit, recruit, hire, or otherwise induce any employee or service provider of the Company to leave or reduce such employment or service relationship. The parties agree that this Section shall be construed and enforced to the maximum extent permitted by applicable law, and that any overbroad restriction shall be modified and enforced to the fullest lawful extent.
edits.name: Restrictive covenants revised for companywide protections
